description: This file contains a PHP class 'SaleModuleCest' which defines acceptance tests for the SuiteCRM Sale Module application. The tests cover creating, viewing, editing, duplicating, and deleting sale records, as well as managing the sale module itself within the SuiteCRM application. It uses the Codeception testing framework and interacts with various parts of the application UI through custom step classes.

classes.name: SaleModuleCest
classes.description: Acceptance test class for the SuiteCRM sale module, covering creation, viewing, editing, duplication, and deletion of sale records, as well as module deployment.
